html.body: Date: 2025-05-06 Remarks By this Amendment, new claims 25 and 26 have been added. Claim 25 includes the subject matter of claim 17, as amended in the Restriction Requirement Response, dated November 6, 2024, and the subject matter of claim 18 as originally filed. Claim 26, which depends from claim 25, recites the subject matter of claim 19 as originally filed. As indicated in the Notice of Allowance, the restriction requirement has been withdrawn as to claims 18 and 19.As approved in the Notice of Allowance, the subject matter of claims 18 and 19 has been effectively reinstated by this Amendment.Respectfully submitted, /Bryan J.
